column1: # harness/coldstart/legs.tsv — the population, one row per leg. TAB separated.
# leg    a name, unique, and the name validate/v111 ratchets on
# entry  the script setup.praat registers, relative to <plugin>/scripts/
# plan   how the leg answers pages: steps separated by ";", one step per page.
#          sN=V  set the Nth optionmenu on this page (top to bottom) to
#                option V, then press the page's last button
#          -     press the page's last button and answer nothing
#          .     the whole plan: open the door and look at what came up.
#                A dot, not an empty cell: TAB is IFS whitespace, so bash
#                COLLAPSES two tabs in a row and every field after an empty
#                one shifts left by one. Measured, not feared.
# kind   entry  = a command registered in setup.praat, opened cold
#        branch = one route through the wizard, which is thirteen-plus doors
#                 wearing one menu entry. Ian's crash was branch-ORDER
#                 dependent, so a single wizard leg would have missed it.
# note   what the leg is for, in one line
